notes: Random-init tiny skycmd-s2 model; the tokenizer is embedded in the GGUF files (byte-level BPE without merges, [NUM] = 5 with lstrip, byte b = id 6 + b).

Expected outputs were computed by the mlx-rs forward pass on the weights read back from each GGUF file (ternary: code x f16 row scale; token_embd: int8 x f16 row scale), i.e. the mlx-rs fake-quant model with f16 scales.
Exits are 0-based: exit e runs state block applications 0..exits[e] then exit.e.norm; temperature keys are temperature.e{e}.{type}[.{bucket}], falling back to e{e}.{type}, then 1.

logits are raw scorer outputs per exit; probs = softmax(logits / temperature). The early-exit answer stops at the first exit whose max prob >= exit_threshold.{type} (always the last exit otherwise): see exit / layers_used.

Static stream: Q = [CLS] head [SEP] at positions 0..|Q|-1, then [MASK] + option tokens with positions restarting at |Q|; Q attends Q, option i attends Q and option i. State stream: [CLS] state [SEP], positions 0..S-1.

Fusion attn_kv rows 0..d are the keys and rows d..2d the values; heads are contiguous 64-wide column blocks (as in attn_qkv). kv = state tokens (exit-normalized) followed by the static question tokens.
phi(v) = [u, sin(u w_0..7), cos(u w_0..7)], u = sign(v) ln(1 + |v|), w_k = 2^k pi / 8.

fuse_numbers (SPEC-S3 1): the merge rule runs on each tokenized text separately (instruction head, each option text, state) right after numeric extraction + BPE and BEFORE the SPEC truncation rules (48-token option cap, head budget, max_state_tokens count merged tokens). A [NUM] at text position 0 stays standalone (so it is standalone after [CLS] / [MASK]); a [NUM] whose previous token already has a value stays standalone; otherwise it is removed and its value moves onto the previous token. Embedding: tok_embd[id] + has_value * (num_proj.weight phi(v) + num_proj.bias). static.has_value / state_stream.has_value give the flags; RoPE positions are the merged positions.

state_loops = 4 (SPEC-S3 2): application a = 0..4 runs blk.(a % 1) ; before each loop l >= 1 (a % B == 0, a > 0) loop_embd.weight[l] is added to the hidden states; block 0 uses no attention norm at a = 0 and blk.0.attn_norm_loop.weight (LayerNorm without bias) on later loops; blocks b > 0 use their own attn_norm. exits count block applications.
